name: NASA International Space Apps Challenge
summary: Selected at the local stage with PolarWindow and now progressing to the global stage. My contribution focuses on mission-analysis research and data inputs for the CLPS lunar mission browser.

name: IBM Bob 2.0 Hackathon
summary: Participated in the online hackathon focused on AI-assisted software development with IBM Bob.

name: The Infinity AI BuildFest
summary: Participated in CloudCamp Bangladesh’s Infinity AI BuildFest, a gathering of builders exploring practical AI-powered products and solutions.

name: Harvard HSIL Hackathon
summary: Selected for participation at the Bangladesh national / Dhaka hub of the Harvard Health Systems Innovation Lab Hackathon. Worked with the team on RadFlow, an offline-first AI radiology triage prototype for district hospitals.
